description: This file contains classes and functions for training and using custom object detection models, specifically YOLOv3, including model training, evaluation, and object detection in images and videos. It defines classes such as DetectionModelTrainer, CustomObjectDetection, and CustomVideoObjectDetection, along with utility classes and functions for handling bounding boxes and model inference.

classes.name: DetectionModelTrainer
classes.description: Class responsible for training YOLOv3 object detection models, managing datasets, training configurations, and evaluation.

classes.name: CustomObjectDetection
classes.description: Class for performing object detection on images using a trained YOLOv3 model.

classes.name: CustomVideoObjectDetection
classes.description: Class for performing object detection on videos or live streams using a trained YOLOv3 model.

classes.name: BoundBox
classes.description: Class representing a bounding box with coordinates, objectness score, class probabilities, and methods for IoU calculation.

classes.name: CustomDetectionUtils
classes.description: Utility class for decoding network outputs, applying non-max suppression, and drawing detection boxes.

methods.name: setModelTypeAsYOLOv3
methods.description: Sets the model type to YOLOv3 for training or detection.

methods.name: setDataDirectory
methods.description: Configures dataset directories for training and validation datasets.

methods.name: setTrainConfig
methods.description: Sets training parameters including object labels, batch size, epochs, and optional pre-trained model.

methods.name: trainModel
methods.description: Starts the training process for the YOLOv3 model.

methods.name: evaluateModel
methods.description: Evaluates a trained model's mAP metrics on validation data.

methods.name: _create_training_instances
methods.description: Parses dataset annotations and splits data for training and validation.

methods.name: _create_callbacks
methods.description: Creates callbacks for model checkpointing, learning rate reduction, and TensorBoard.

methods.name: _create_model
methods.description: Builds and compiles the YOLOv3 model, optionally with multi-GPU support.

methods.name: setModelTypeAsYOLOv3
methods.description: Sets the detection model type to YOLOv3.

methods.name: setModelPath
methods.description: Specifies the path to the trained detection model weights.

methods.name: setJsonPath
methods.description: Sets the path to the detection configuration JSON file.

methods.name: loadModel
methods.description: Loads the detection model and configuration for inference.

methods.name: detectObjectsFromImage
methods.description: Performs object detection on an input image, returning detected objects and optionally saving or extracting objects.

methods.name: detectObjectsFromVideo
methods.description: Performs object detection on a video or live stream, with support for callbacks at various intervals.
